Looking at this question, I need to identify which over-the-counter antihistamine has shown efficacy comparable to anti-VISTA antibodies when combined with immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) therapy in mouse models, specifically regarding survival prolongation and lung metastasis inhibition.

Key considerations:
- The antihistamine must be available over-the-counter
- It must have been tested in combination with ICB therapy
- It must show effects comparable to anti-VISTA antibodies on survival and lung metastasis in mice

Fexofenadine (brand name Allegra) is a well-known second-generation OTC antihistamine. Research has demonstrated that fexofenadine can enhance the efficacy of immune checkpoint blockade therapy in preclinical models, showing results comparable to anti-VISTA antibodies in terms of prolonged survival and inhibition of lung metastasis in mice.

[ANSWER]B[/ANSWER]
